This is expected behaviour. When Rich's output is not a terminal (here, stdout piped through `tee`), it does not use cursor control codes, so each refresh is printed as a new line. Running the script directly in a terminal updates in place, as you found.

If you need the in-place display while writing to a file or pipe, set `force_terminal=True` on the `Console`. See [console.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). Related earlier report: #2326. For further help, use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
